references.text: Isaac's blessing to Jacob includes the promise of dew from heaven and the richness of the earth, grain and wine - the same themes found in Moses' blessing over Israel.
The promise of living securely in the land is a recurring theme in the covenant blessings.
Balaam's prophecy describes Israel as a people who dwell alone, set apart from other nations - the same idea as 'dwelling securely by themselves'.
Jeremiah uses the same expression about Israel dwelling securely, with reference to the Lord's protection.
Zechariah promises that the sky will give dew and the earth its produce as part of the future blessing - the same imagery found in Deuteronomy.
